subject: Chrysochroa fulgidissima
creator: 林孫鋒(Lin Sun Fong)
alt: An iridescent green jewel beetle on a tree trunk has lifted its striped wing covers and is beating its translucent flight wings. The photographer credit remains visible along the lower edge.
detail: Raised wing covers and beating flight wings beside bark support the flight scene. First-flight recollection, return and mistaken tree movement are fiction. Embedded photographer credit remains intact.
